caption: The drawing depicts an aerial view of a sectioned landscape composed of green fields, plots with varied vegetation, and several small, rectangular red-roofed white buildings. The fields are divided by light-colored pathways or roads that intersect at right angles, forming a grid with distinct rectangular and square plots. Some areas within the plots are filled with orderly rows of plants or trees, while others are open grassy spaces edged with trees. There are three red-roofed white structures, each surrounded by some trees, located in different sections of the landscape. At the top center of the drawing, there is a decorative crest featuring a tree, a shield with symbols, and the phrase "EX LIBRIS" beneath it. The color palette is dominated by shades of green for the fields, blue and purple for the background and sky, and pinkish-brown for the pathways, with accents of white and red on the buildings. The entire scene is bordered by a light-colored margin.
title: J. Dyckman Estate
